email.subject: Re: Renewal quote request for Summit Ridge Construction Inc. — Policy CPP-6612078
email.body:
Good morning Maya,

Please prepare the renewal quote for Summit Ridge Construction Inc. (policy CPP-6612078) ahead of the upcoming expiration date. The account is a commercial general contractor handling ground-up construction, tenant improvements, and site work at 9400 E Arapahoe Rd, Centennial, CO 80112.

If possible, please keep the renewal effective date at 08/01/2025 and let us know if you need any updated underwriting information from Derek Olsson.

Thank you,
Derek Olsson
Summit Ridge Construction Inc.
